title_sq: "OKAZION" APARTAMENT 2+1+2 NE SHITJE, TIRANA NEW ENTRY 3

title_en: "OCAZION" APARTMENT 2+1+2 FOR SALE, TIRANA NEW ENTRY 3
description_en: The residential residence Tirana Entry III comes to meet your requirements for residential and commercial spaces in a single environment. This new project includes two buildings which are a continuation of the architectural concept of "Tirana Entry II", creating visual and functional harmony with the surrounding area. The building is in the construction phase and is expected to be completed in 2026. Surface 95.4 m2. Organization: Living room, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 1 balcony. 6th Floor South-West Orientation. Strategic position, with all facilities and a distance of 3 km from the center of Tirana. Accessible area with entrance and exit from the city. Ventilated facade IDEAL INVESTMENT OR RESIDENTIAL OPPORTUNITY. The apartment can only be purchased with full payment (not installments). For more information or a visit to the property, contact us!
